text:
erin-ops: Quick follow-up from the PM: we keep seeing a recurring spike of LB->DNS retries and elevated TLS handshake errors after last week's routing flip. Need an owner for remediation, a short timeline (days), and a clear rollback plan. Not a full postmortem here, just an action tracker.

jordan-sre: I can take initial ownership for triage. Plan: 1) reproduce in staging, 2) identify offending routing rule, 3) propose either patch or rollback. ETA EOD tomorrow for a reproduction update. :+1:

liam-net: FYI the pattern looks like cross-region TTL + sticky route mismatch — caches invalidated and we see a flood of retries. I can audit the CDN/LB config today. If we confirm, rollback is trivial (restore previous route weights).

samuel-n: I'll run the telemetry queries and surface the exact time windows and affected clusters. Query I'll run:```sql
SELECT region, lb, count(*) as retries
FROM requests
WHERE response_code IN (502,504) AND ts BETWEEN ts-30m AND ts+30m
GROUP BY region, lb
ORDER BY retries DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Will paste results into the tracker.

alex-ml: Also worth checking the KV cache invalidation rate — our runtime's prefix cache saw a jump which can amplify token-level latency and cause TLS timeouts in vulnerable paths. I'll correlate KV evict metrics with the retry spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy 2209876401 (routing-config-v2) succeeded in prod at 2026-03-22T17:06:41Z by @release-engineering

oncall-bot: paging erin-ops and jordan-sre because retry rate passed 0.8% threshold in region-eu-west at 2026-03-22T17:14:03Z

erin-ops: Jordan/LIam/Samuel — please add the following fields to the central tracker: owner, short description, mitigation option (rollback/patch), ETA, and whether it needs an on-call page. I'll consolidate and send to infra leads.

jordan-sre: Added a row: owner=jordan-sre, desc=confirm rule affinity mismatch, mitigation=rollback weights, ETA=tomorrow EOD, oncall=no.

liam-net: Added audit notes: tested LB weight restore in staging; will schedule a canary rollback window if triage shows config is culprit. ETA for canary ready = 6h.

samuel-n: Telemetry paste (summary): region-eu-west spike 17:12-17:20 UTC, retries ~18k, TLS handshake errors +14%. Affected service routes: model-ingest, api-gateway. Full CSV in tracker.

alex-ml: KV cache eviction correlation: eviction spikes aligned at 17:10 UTC on nodes serving model-ingest. Suggest enabling prefix caching hold for 10m as an interim if rollback is not desirable.

erin-ops: Decision tree: if rollback removes spike in staging, roll prod weights back by 90% and monitor for 30m. If rollback not effective, apply cache hold and throttle new sessions for 10m. Jordan please own the rollback steps and liaise with Release Eng. Liam handle LB weight change. Samuel keep telemetry live. Alex implement cache hold if needed.

jordan-sre: On it. I'll coordinate with @release-engineering in #release to schedule an immediate canary rollback if staging confirms. Keeping the runbook handy.

liam-net: Prepared the LB rollback commands (staging tested):```bash
# restore previous weights from snapshot
redwood-lbctl set-weights --route model-ingest --snapshot 2026-03-21T23:58:00Z
redwood-lbctl set-weights --route api-gateway --snapshot 2026-03-21T23:58:00Z
```
I'll only run after Jordan gives 👍 and we have a controlled canary.

samuel-n: I'll keep the monitoring dashboard pinned and post updates every 15m until this is resolved. First update at 18:00 UTC.

erin-ops: Thanks team. Can everyone put a one-line status update in the tracker when you finish your step? I'll run a short follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. If anything spikes before then, ping #incidents. :eyes:

jordan-sre: Confirmed — will add status and timestamp after rollback test.

liam-net: Will be on standby for weight restore.

samuel-n: First telemetry update posted to tracker.

alex-ml: If we end up enabling cache hold, I'll add the watchlist metrics to the console and set a 10m auto-revert.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollback window (canary) requested by jordan-sre for route model-ingest at 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z

oncall-bot: resolved alert: retry rate back under threshold at 2026-03-22T18:22:31Z — monitoring continues

erin-ops: Closing loop for now — rollback canary succeeded in prod and metrics are stable. We'll keep the tracker open for any regression. Thanks everyone. :tada:
